_comment: HAND-BUILT, not captured from the API. PUSH's Dead Bug carries reps: 12 alongside rep_range {12,12} — the two AGREE, so no assertion on it can tell 'reps wins' apart from 'rep_range wins'. This fixture makes them DISAGREE (reps: 12 vs {8,10}) so AC3.3's precedence rule is pinned. Its second exercise is metric-native (weight_kg: 20) — the only shape that separates 'round kg to 2dp' from 'round-trip through lbs', since lbsToKg(kgToLbs(20)) === 19.96 (AC3.5).

exercises.title: Disagreeing Reps
exercises.notes: reps and rep_range disagree; reps wins and no max is written.
